name: A2 Takeoff Calc
subtitle: Feet-inch calculator & takeoff
promotionalText: A feet-inch-fraction calculator with takeoffs for stud walls, block walls and concrete. Dimensioned plans and 3D views. Free, no ads, no account.
description:
A construction calculator that speaks feet, inches and fractions, with quick takeoffs you can see: a dimensioned floor plan, a wall-by-wall drawing and a 3D view of what you're building.

FEET, INCHES AND FRACTIONS
Type it the way you say it: 5' 3 1/2" + 2' 10 3/4" = 8' 2 1/4". Areas and volumes come out in square feet, square yards, cubic feet or cubic yards. Squares, cubes and roots, parentheses, a tape of everything you worked out, and memory letters A to F. Round to 1/16", 1/8" or whatever you work to.

STUD WALLS
Lay out walls one after another, turning left or right, with doors and windows. Get full-height studs, kings, jacks, headers, cripples, sills and plates, a cut list and what to buy in stock lengths. Drag a window along the wall and watch it reframe.

BLOCK WALLS AND GROUT
Grout for a CMU wall, solid or cells at a spacing, with the cells at corners, wall ends and each side of every door and window. Lintels over openings, either lintel block grouted with the wall or formed and poured, shown as their own concrete. Block count too.

CONCRETE
Slabs, footings, walls, beams, columns and round piers, with waste and pump loss, rounded up to what you order.

SEE IT
Every takeoff has a dimensioned plan (tap a wall to edit it) and a 3D view you can turn and zoom.

CONVERSIONS
Lengths, areas and volumes between imperial and metric.

FREE AND PRIVATE
No ads, no account, no tracking. Nothing you enter leaves your device. A2 Calc is open source under the MIT license.

Use at your own risk: these are estimates. Check every quantity against the plans and with your supplier before you order or bid.
reviewNotes:
A2 Calc is a construction calculator (feet, inches and fractions) with takeoffs for stud walls, block walls and concrete. No account or sign-in; the app makes no network requests and keeps everything on the device.

Things to try: type 5' 3 1/2" + 2' 10 3/4" = on the calculator (the ' and " keys); menu > Takeoff > Stud wall, then switch the Plan view to 3D and drag a window in the wall drawing; Takeoff > Block fill grout and Concrete work the same way.
